attchmntText: The Exchange has been informed regarding the publication of the Offer Opening Advertisement cum Corrigendum to the Public Announcement in connection with the Buyback of fully paid-up Equity Shares through the Tender Offer route on a proportionate basis, pursuant to the SEBI (Buy-back) Regulations. The advertisement was published on November 18, 2026, in the following newspapers:Business Standard   English (All Editions)Business Standard   Hindi (All Editions)Navshakti   Marathi (Mumbai Edition)
voiceSummary: FDC Limited completed the dispatch of Letter of Offer and Tender Forms for its equity share buyback on November 16, 2026, via electronic mode, and on November 17, 2026, via Speedpost. An Offer Opening Advertisement cum Corrigendum was published on November 18, 2026, in Business Standard, Navshakti, and other specified newspapers. The information is available on the company website at www.fdcindia.com. Separately, Naga Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Standalone net profit was 10.45 Crores, with consolidated net profit at 10.96 Crores. Basic and diluted earnings per share were Rs. 7.19 and Rs. 7.54 respectively. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 11, 2026. Additionally, Relybulls Stock Broking Private Limited requested the surrender of its trading membership with the National Stock Exchange of India. The last date for filing complaints against the trading member is December 2, 2026.

attchmntText: FDC Limited has informed the Exchange about Buyback of equity Shares - Copy of Letter of Offer along with the Tender Forms for DEMAT & Physical Shareholders
voiceSummary: FDC Limited submitted a Letter of Offer for a buyback of fully paid-up equity shares. The Board approved the buyback on October 27, 2026. The company proposes to buyback 24,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 500 per share. The aggregate amount is up to Rs. 120.00 Crores. The record date is November 13, 2026. The buyback offer opens on November 19, 2026. It closes on November 26, 2026. Settlement of bids is scheduled for December 03, 2026. The buyback is conducted through a tender offer route.
